# Sarva Capital

> Official directory of Sarva Capital web properties, educational utilities, and public resources.

Website: https://sarvacapital.in/
Contact: contact@sarvacapital.in

## Main Site Pages

- [Home](https://sarvacapital.in/): Overview of Sarva Capital and its active digital platforms.
- [About](https://sarvacapital.in/about/): Mission, products, and editorial standards.
- [Privacy Policy](https://sarvacapital.in/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices and Google AdSense cookie disclosures.

## Subdomains & Public Platforms

### Telangana RTA LLR Practice
- [Telangana RTA LLR Practice (STALL Simulator)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/): Free trilingual (English, Telugu, Hindi) 412-question Telangana Learner's Licence simulator, road signs, RTO guide, DL track guide, and traffic fines.
- [LLR LLM Summary (llms.txt)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/llms.txt)
- [LLR Complete Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/llms-full.txt)
- [All 94 Telangana Road Signs](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/road-signs/)
- [412 Official LLR Questions & Answers](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/question-bank/)
- [Hyderabad & Telangana RTO Guide](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/rto-guide/)
- [Permanent DL 8-Track & H-Track Guide](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/dl-test-guide/)
- [Telangana Traffic Fines & Hand Signals](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/traffic-fines/)
- [All 38 Telangana District RTO Codes](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/telangana-rto-codes/)
- [Last-Minute LLR Cheatsheet](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/cheatsheet/)
- [Telugu Overview](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/te/)
- [Hindi Overview](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/hi/)

### Sarva TV
- [Sarva TV](https://sarvatv.sarvacapital.in/): Streamlined web companion for discovering and watching curated live channels and digital streams.
